st: Las Vegas: A New Elease on Life
d: Tired of the drama, several of the girls attempt to call a truce with Elease. Amy christens the house by cheating on her guy back home.

st: Las Vegas: Invasion of the Scavengers
d: Erica reunites with the twins after the other roommates get under her skin  Mimi's relationship with Elease makes her a target.
The twins leave the house for good  the girls try to get Mimi to return to the house.
Mimi has a breakdown that makes Elease feel queasy  Amy finds solace and more in Camilla.

st: Las Vegas: Go Big Go Home
d: Camilla fights to stay to the end  the remaining Bad Girls get sentimental.
Meghan's lingerie-themed birthday party forces the girls to put their differences aside.
Rima endures three days of Erica's fury while Julie, Mehgan, and Falen execute their master plan to break up the Sad Girls, sending an unexpected house mate packing.
Julie and Falen begin to see Mehgan's true colors  Rima ditches the drama with her boyfriend back at home.
